basic_info.description: Inner Sunset remodeled home conveniently located just short blocks to vibrant Irving Street shops and restaurants, Andranico's, UCSF Medical Center, Golden Gate Park, and Judah Street MUNI lines. This remodeled home features 3 bedrooms & 2 baths on the top floor plus laundry closet. Main level offer spacious living room, kitchen, large dining room/family room, small office, powder room, and large rear deck. Ground floor is good for one car parking plus lot of storage space. Large leveled yard!
